name: NLWP Longest Road PPV, 19 May 1997

date.source: The broadcast's own dateline; posted the same day to the newsgroup.

no_appearances_reason: Character-level minting is deferred (a wing accessions on its holdings, not its exhaustion); the vacant title's new champion is recorded in this wing's own titles.json/reigns.json as an unminted name for now rather than left off the registry entirely.
notes: A joint pay-per-view staged with the International Internet Wrestling Federation and the Electronic Shoot Wrestling Promotion under a talent-exchange arrangement between the three federations: a twenty-man Royal Rumble, ten of its entrants from this federation and five each from the other two, decides the promotion's own World Heavyweight Championship, left vacant ahead of the event by the promotion's own on-screen Commissioner. Also on the card, both successfully defended: the World Tag Team Championship and the North American Championship.
